title: Routes
intro: Manage station pairs, estimated journey duration and route availability.
formHint: A route is directional. Origin and destination must be different.
deleteHint: Delete {name}? Routes linked to trips cannot be deleted.
exists: A route in this direction already exists.
hasTrips: This route has trips. Create another route to change its stations.
inUse: This route is in use and cannot be deleted.
notFound: This route no longer exists. Refresh the list.
missingStation: A selected station no longer exists. Refresh the list.
readFailedHint: Refresh to load complete routes and station choices.
staleHint: The displayed records may be out of date. Refresh before making changes.
emptyHint: Adjust the filters or add a route after creating its stations.
